senses.gloss: ch. same, to be smooth, lax; to be forgiving, renounce; to be sweet.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 4:26">Targ. O. Gen. IV, 26</cite> <he>חָליּ וכ׳</he> men became lax in worshipping.—
<cite ref="Ketubot 86a:1">Keth. 86ᵃ</cite> top <he>תיזיל ותֵיחוּל וכ׳</he> Alf. (ed. <he>ותיחלה</he>, Asheri <he>ותימחל</he>) let her go and renounce her mother’s widowhood in favor of her father.—
Gitt. 47ᵃ דלֵיחוֹל אַדְּמֵיה that he (the gladiator) may be in a forgiving mood for his life (which he is forced to risk); [oth. opin. דלֵיחוֹל אִדְמֵיה that his blood may be sweet, Ar. s. v. אדמא].
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 60a:11">B. Mets. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>דילמא טפי ומְחַיְּילֵיה וכ׳</he> lest he may add unmixed wine and improve it, and then sell it (for pure wine).

senses.gloss: (אַחֲלֵי, fr. חלי) to be liberal, to forgive.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 12b:12">Ber. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>אֲחִילוּ ליה מן וכ׳</he> they in heaven forgave him.

<cite ref="Shabbat 30a:8">Sabb. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>דא׳ להו עון וכ׳</he> He pardoned them for the violation of the Day of Atonement; <cite ref="Moed Katan 9a">M. Kat. 9ᵃ</cite>. Keth. l. c. <he>אֲחִילְתָּהּ</he> she renounced it, v. supra.—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 73a">B. Mets. 73ᵃ</cite> <he>אֲחוּלֵי</he> … <he>מַחֲלֵי וכ׳</he> Ms. R. (ed. <he>אוזולי … מוזלי</he>, v. <cite ref="G00174"><he>זוּל</he></cite> I ch.) they were liberal towards you.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 144a:5">B. Bath. 144ᵃ</cite> <he>אחולי אַחֲלָה</he> she resigned her claim. [<cite ref="Moed Katan 17a:4">M. Kat. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>מיתחיל</he> = <he>מִתְחֲלִיל</he>, v. <cite ref="H01074"><he>חֲלַל</he></cite>.] V. <cite ref="M00886"><he>מְחַל</he></cite>.
